description: What one sub-agent of the agent in a pane (Claude Code or Codex) has done so far, from the transcript the agent keeps on disk: the task it was given, what it wrote and reasoned, the tools it called and what they returned, oldest first. Works while the sub-agent runs (`working`) and after it finished, as long as the agent runs. Read-only.

limit.description: The most items returned, the latest ones: 200 when absent, at most 1000.

pane.description: Pane id of the agent, e.g. `%5`.

TranscriptItem.description: One step of a sub-agent's transcript.

error.description: The tool reported a failure (`tool_result` only).

text.description: The text, cut at 4 000 characters (then ending in `…`). A tool call's is its main argument: the command, path, pattern or query, else the whole input as JSON.

tool.description: The tool's name, on `tool_call` and `tool_result` items.

oneOf.description: A message to the sub-agent after its task, from the agent that runs it.
Its reasoning, when the agent records it in clear.
A tool it called, with the call's main argument.

response_schema.description: What one sub-agent has done so far, from the transcript its agent keeps.

agent.description: Matcher id of that agent: `claude` or `codex`.

items.description: The latest items, oldest first, without the task.

pane_id.description: Pane id of the agent running the sub-agent.

prompt.description: The task it was given, cut at 16 000 characters. Null when the transcript holds none; Codex keeps a sub-agent's task encrypted, so there it shows only the task's name and sender.

truncated.description: Older items were left out: past `limit`, or before the last 4 MiB of the file.

working.description: The sub-agent is still in its agent's `subagents` list.

response_schema.title: SubagentTranscript
